title: Construct behavioral nulls

knownInputs: S03 found that every retained primary paper backtrack was nonworsening under all four global rank metrics, with six frozen-C coverage gaps.
S07 provides exact structural reachability, necessary excursion, and cost labels for every retained S05 state and metric.
S09 supplies 25,224 persistent baseline/remove/move/add runs from 3,328 exact structural contexts; activation pulses are excluded because they do not define a persistent S05 family.
S10 supplies strict-filter exposure and exact filtered-reachability strata for each persistent run and metric.
freezeBoundary.forbidden: No S11 null outcome may be opened before this contract is committed to the workspace.

frozenQuestion: Can non-adaptive structural policies generate apparent detours, and do they differ from observed S09 behavior in barrier contingency, completion, residual error, or successful-run efficiency after the declared S09/S10 stratification?
evidenceBoundary: All nulls are finite paths in the frozen S05 fair-serial structural opportunity graph. They are neither byte-exact E01 scheduler replays nor estimates under an undeclared scheduler distribution.

cohort.exclusionReason: The one-event activation pulse has no persistent S05 family and cannot be represented by a stationary structural null without changing semantics.

nullFamilies.definition: At each active state, choose uniformly from all authoritative outgoing S05 opportunity edges, including accepted changes, native no-ops, and native rejections.

Use independently randomized systematic quotas targeting the anchor run's accepted-swap, memory-update, and unchanged-opportunity rates; choose uniformly within the requested feasible outgoing edge category and audit a uniform-all-edge fallback only when that category is absent.

Predeclare a state-independent sequence of family opportunity ordinals from the S05 opportunity probabilities, then execute the uniquely corresponding authoritative edge at each visited state. The opportunity labels are open-loop; native proposals remain state-dependent.
Choose an outgoing S05 edge with the smallest immediate adjacent-descents successor level; break all ties with an independent declared stream.
Choose an outgoing S05 edge with the smallest immediate inversion-count successor level; break all ties with an independent declared stream.
Choose an outgoing S05 edge with the smallest immediate Spearman-footrule successor level; break all ties with an independent declared stream.
Choose an outgoing S05 edge with the smallest immediate maximum-rank-error successor level; break all ties with an independent declared stream.

edgeAndCostSemantics.costs: Sum the selected S05 edge ledger. Report S06 full-ledger cost separately from E01's redundant proposal-inclusive full ledger.
edgeAndCostSemantics.openLoopWeighting: the exact state-independent S05 opportunity numerator/denominator measure

streams.generator: counter-addressed SplitMix64 with SHA-256-derived 64-bit stream roots
streams.independence: Distinct roots for null family, greedy metric, quota phase, selection tie, and replicate; no E01 or S09 scheduler stream is reused.
streams.barrierPairing: Within a source-start, focal barrier, replicate, and null family block, all intervention arms share raw counter values. State/family differences may map the same raw values to different opportunities and are reported as common-random-number coupling rather than identical action streams.
streams.moduloBias: Use multiply-high mapping from an unsigned 64-bit draw to a bounded integer.

strata: S10 strict filter exposure for the evaluation metric
S09 exact reachability status for the evaluation metric
S10 strict filtered exact reachability and intervention-created impossibility for the evaluation metric
architecture, n, direction, and policy profile

outcomeSeparation.quiescence: S05 terminal quiescent; unsuccessful and never censoring.
outcomeSeparation.censoring: S07-reachable run still active at the declared event budget.
outcomeSeparation.residualError: Final exact metric numerator, reported for all runs.
outcomeSeparation.successfulRunEfficiency: Cost contrasts and exact optimality gaps only when the relevant run or pair completed; a shorter failed run is never efficient.

eventBudgetSensitivity.scope: replicate-zero null runs that are exactly reachable and active at 2048

comparisons: null-versus-observed completion, residual error, excursion, and costs
barrier arm versus matched baseline within each null family
null successful-run costs versus S07 exact optima
inference.claimBoundary: Null contrasts are descriptive computational controls. Barrier common-random-number contrasts are paired within the structural null but do not identify biological adaptation.

validation: all 25,224 observed anchors and all seven null families are present
every selected edge is an authoritative outgoing S05 edge and all terminal labels agree
rate requests match declared anchor rates and achieved-category deficits are fully accounted
open-loop ordinal sequences are state-independent and map to feasible authoritative edges
counter streams are independently rooted and matched barrier arms share declared raw prefixes
deterministic replay reproduces every null summary and trajectory digest
every run-metric row joins exactly to S07 and S10 strata
exact impossibility, quiescence, censoring, completion, residual error, and successful efficiency remain disjoint
all required long-horizon prefixes match their 2,048-event runs
all accessed inputs are byte-unchanged and no S12 artifact exists
